qualifier: heme scavenging and transferrin-mediated iron uptake
name: Transition metal and heme membrane transport and homeostasis
rationale: All members concern membrane transport, homeostasis or detoxification of iron, copper, zinc, manganese, cobalt or cadmium; unlike the zinc-centred and metal-response confusables, the theme adds heme uptake/scavenging and plasma-membrane iron import.

qualifier: HIV entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
name: HIV early infection and APOBEC3 cytidine-deaminase restriction
rationale: Members span HIV binding, uncoating and minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis together with APOBEC3G/C-to-U deamination that restricts it; the early HIV life-cycle steps are what the confusables (integration, demethylation, translation) lack.

qualifier: BH3-only protein (PUMA, NOXA) activation and cytochrome c release
name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis via BH3-only proteins
rationale: All members are TP53-driven transcription of death genes or the PUMA/NOXA BH3-only arm leading to cytochrome c release; this pairing separates it from GO-only p53 apoptosis terms and from BAX/BAK pore-formation themes.

qualifier: amino acids, oligopeptides and urate, with inherited aminoacidurias
name: Epithelial amino acid, oligopeptide and urate membrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated plasma-membrane transport of amino acids, di/oligopeptides and urate in kidney and gut epithelia plus their inherited defects; the amino acid/peptide focus distinguishes it from the hexose-transport and organic-ion-transport confusables.

qualifier: termination control and R-loop processing
name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation including termination and R-loops
rationale: Members regulate Pol II initiation, elongation and termination and chromatin access, with transcription-associated R-loop processing and termination control distinguishing it from rRNA/RNA-processing and elongation-complex confusables.

core: Ubiquitin-like modification control of NF-kappaB signalling
qualifier: K63 deubiquitination and SUMOylation
name: K63 deubiquitination and SUMOylation restraining NF-kappaB signalling
rationale: Members concern regulation of NF-kappaB/transcription-factor activity by K63-linked deubiquitination, ubiquitin activation and SUMOylation; NF-kappaB restraint with SUMOylation separates it from generic DUB families (C1, C3) and from TNFR1/linear-ubiquitin signalling (C2).

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control and ERAD
name: Atypical ubiquitin chain assembly in misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members are K6/K11/K27/K29/branched and free ubiquitin chain formation alongside protein unfolding, quality control and ERAD promotion; the quality-control arm separates it from DUB/proteasome confusables and the chain-type arm from the ERAD/reticulophagy confusable.

qualifier: bilirubin and drug glucuronidation with SLCO uptake
name: Bilirubin and drug glucuronidation and hepatic organic anion uptake
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole breakdown to bilirubin, UDP-glucuronate/UGT conjugation, SLCO/ABCC2 anion transport defects and drug ADME; glucuronidation and drug ADME distinguish it from xenobiotic-export confusables, and the bilirubin arm from general xenobiotic metabolism.

qualifier: fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
name: Antimicrobial killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members concern direct killing or starving of microbes (cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity) in antifungal and Gram-positive defence, distinct from the respiratory-burst, degranulation and mucosal-agglutination confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor control of lipid and glucose metabolism
qualifier: liver X receptors
name: Liver X receptor control of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3)-driven gene programmes for lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis plus nuclear-receptor transcription, SUMOylation and VLDL remodelling; the LXR receptor focus separates it from adipogenesis/PPARG and PGC-1alpha/circadian confusables.

qualifier: C-type lectin receptors and IL-1-family (IL-18, IL-36-38) signalling
name: Antifungal C-type lectin, IL-1-family and Th17 cytokine responses
rationale: Members link Dectin/DC-SIGN fungal sensing, IL-18/36/37/38 signalling and IL-17/Th17 and IL-12/23 production; the IL-1-family and C-type lectin arms distinguish it from IL-10/IL-12-family, IL-33 and dendritic-cell cytokine confusables.

qualifier: endopeptidase activity regulation
name: Antigen-driven hypersensitivity, inflammation and protease regulation
rationale: Members concern type II/IV hypersensitivity, ADCC and antigen-induced acute inflammation, with endopeptidase regulation being what distinguishes it from the neutrophil and Fc-receptor confusables.

qualifier: GPCR-stimulated cAMP synthesis
name: GPCR-stimulated cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members concern GPCR/forskolin-driven cAMP production and PKA activation; cAMP synthesis and GPCR coupling distinguish it from inhibitory-cyclase and CREB/calcium-cyclase confusables.

core: Cellular responses to transition and heavy metal ions
qualifier: MTF1-metallothionein induction
name: Heavy metal ion responses with metallothionein induction
rationale: Members are responses to zinc, copper, manganese, cobalt, iron, lead, mercury and selenium with MTF1/metallothionein induction, distinct from cadmium-transport, xenobiotic AhR and oxidative HMOX1 confusables.

qualifier: B cell homeostasis and T follicular helper help
name: Germinal centre B cell and T follicular helper regulation
rationale: Members concern germinal-centre formation, GC B cell and Tfh differentiation, ICOS co-stimulation, memory and B cell survival/proliferation control; GC/Tfh and homeostasis terms distinguish it from plasma-cell and generic B cell confusables.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly/reassembly and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi positioning, ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly and membrane tubulation, distinct from COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi retention confusables.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: Telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking for telomere extension
rationale: Members concern telomerase holoenzyme assembly, scaRNA/telomerase RNA routing to Cajal bodies and recruitment to telomeres for lengthening, distinct from telomere capping, C-strand synthesis and senescence confusables.

qualifier: germinal centre, memory and plasma cell fates
name: B cell differentiation into germinal centre, memory and plasma cells
rationale: Members are B cell differentiation programmes and signatures leading to germinal-centre, memory and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells; plasma-cell differentiation and Tfh/ICOS help distinguish it from B cell proliferation/BCR confusables.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation, including MHC class Ib recognition
name: Bidirectional regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members regulate NK activation, degranulation and cytotoxicity and T cell cytotoxicity in both directions with NK signatures; activating/inhibitory regulation and MHC Ib presentation distinguish it from granzyme, KIR-tolerance and T cell proliferation confusables.

qualifier: complement cascade, defensins and pathogen evasion
name: Innate antimicrobial defence with complement activation and pathogen evasion
rationale: Members span antimicrobial peptides, neutrophil granule arsenal, phagosome maturation, complement activation and Mtb/Listeria subversion of host defences; the complement cascade distinguishes it from its closest confusable and defensins/pathogen evasion from neutrophil-activation confusables.

core: Nucleosome remodeling in DNA replication and repair
qualifier: ADP-ribosylation control
name: Replication- and repair-coupled nucleosome remodeling with ADP-ribosylation control
rationale: Members concern chromatin assembly/disassembly and remodeling coupled to replication and repair, with ADP-ribosylation regulation distinguishing it from CENP-A and acetylation confusables and replication chromatin assembly from PARP/DSB confusables.

qualifier: COPI transport and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
name: COPI and Rab GTPase-regulated Golgi traffic and organization
rationale: Members cover COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, vesicle targeting/tethering, Golgi organization and Rab/ARF regulation including prenylation; Rab regulation separates it from TGN-endosome-lysosome confusables and COPI/Golgi organization from others.

core: Dendritic cell chemokine and cytokine production
qualifier: CCL5 regulation and cGAS-STING activation
name: Dendritic cell CCL5 and cytokine production linked to STING
rationale: Members concern myeloid dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production with positive cGAS-STING signalling; STING activation distinguishes it from macrophage chemokine and Th1 confusables and CCL5/DC cytokines from the TREX1/interferon confusable.

qualifier: break sensing and NHEJ versus homologous recombination choice
name: Double-strand break sensing and NHEJ versus HR choice
rationale: Members concern DSB sensing/ATM signalling, classical and alternative NHEJ and opposing regulation of NHEJ and HR, distinct from resection/MMEJ, PARP chromatin and BRCA1/2-defect confusables.

qualifier: retinol uptake and retinoic acid synthesis
name: Retinoid metabolism, retinol uptake and retinoic acid synthesis
rationale: Members concern vitamin A (retinol, retinal, retinoic acid) metabolism and transport including STRA6-dependent uptake; retinoic acid biosynthesis distinguishes it from the visual-cycle confusable and the uptake/disease terms from retinoid-response and vitamin D confusables.
